body.name: Projected outer confidence surface
body.construction: For every \((\delta_D,\delta_S)\in\mathcal B\), let \(\mathcal C_n(\delta_D,\delta_S)=\bigcup_{\pi'\in\mathcal P_n}\Theta_I(q(\pi');\delta_D,\delta_S)\), where candidates with zero conditioning mass are omitted and \(q(\pi')\) is obtained by the arm-conditioning map in \(\text{def:observed-masses}\).
